entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Is that the entirety of your testimony?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Do you have no intention of saying[n]anything more? Or is the overdose[n]affecting your memory...?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: In any case, it seems it'd be a waste of[n]time to speak to you any longer.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Man
entries.en: That trivial righteousness that you've[n]paraded around?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Man
entries.en: This is how such idiocy ends.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I had even warned you that ruin is nigh.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your game only brought ruin to yourself[n]in the end...
